preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.
Each test case consists of exactly four lines, each containing two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(all(x == int(x) and y == int(y) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 and 0 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in [line.split() for line in test_case_lines]) for test_case_lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)])
preconditions.description: Each coordinate (x, y) is an integer between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set((int(x), int(y)) for x, y in test_case_lines)) == 4 for test_case_lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)])
preconditions.description: All four points in each test case are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one integer per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == str(min_steps) for i, min_steps in enumerate(compute_min_steps(test_cases)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum number of steps required to form a square with sides parallel to the axes.

postconditions.expression: all(min_steps == min(sum(abs(x - a) + abs(y - b) for (x, y) in points) for a, b in possible_centers) for points, min_steps in [(parse_points(test_case_lines), compute_min_steps([test_case_lines])[0]) for test_case_lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)]])
postconditions.description: The minimum steps are computed by evaluating all possible square configurations (centered at (a, b) with side length s) and selecting the one with the least total movement.
